rca of the issue: Root cause (iter35): absolutely positioned `.absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 p-3 text-white` div was stacking above the action button row and intercepting pointer events because it had no `pointer-events-none`. Fix adds the class so the overlay is purely visual; underlying Link still receives clicks (confirmed by image-click navigation test), and sibling button row below is unobstructed.
